context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 107 verified the new Module System implementation. Backend routes at /api/tenant-admin/modules (GET modules, PUT toggle, PUT feature toggle, GET usage). User module-access routes at /api/users/{email}/module-access and /api/users/{email}/scope. Frontend page at /admin/modules with Modules & Features tab and Usage & Limits tab. All 5 modules: core_classification (foundation), buy_planning (operations), inventory_management (inventory), space_planning (space), ai_insights (analytics). Core modules (first 3) cannot be disabled. Features have is_core flag - core features cannot be disabled. Module Config link in sidebar under ADMIN and SUPER ADMIN sections.
